metadata.title: Snowflake jumps on results beat, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
Updated 1 hour ago
Snowflake jumps on results beat, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in premarket action:
Shares in Snowflake surged 25% after the computer software company posted a 35% rise in revenue in its second quarter, beating analysts' estimates, and raised its outlook for the year.
Broadcom's stock tumbled 3.5% as while the chipmaker's guidance for the November-ending period met Wall Street expectations, it likely came below market predictions.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise fell 3.5% despite surpassing consensus in its fiscal third quarter revenue and EPS as investors mull supply constraints as demand among businesses for artificial-intelligence tools booms.
Netskope shares are jumping 13% after strong earnings sparked a raft of price target upgrades for the cybersecurity cstock.
Several of Broadcom's rivals also declined following its results, with Marvell Technology down close to 1% and Intel and Micron Technology down just over 0.5%.
